description: Essential TOEIC terms focusing on market trends, office organization, forecasting, and workplace relations.

nouns.example: Investors are concerned about the constant fluctuation in oil prices.
The main focus of today's meeting is the upcoming product launch.
Make a sharp fold at the top of the page to mark your place.

nouns.meaning: bìa đựng hồ sơ, kẹp tài liệu
nouns.example: Please organize these invoices into the blue folder on my desk.
The sales force has been doubled to reach more potential customers.
The weather forecast predicts heavy rain for the weekend.
Applicants are required to fill out an application form online.
Rising fuel costs have impacted the shipping industry significantly.
The main function of this software is to track inventory in real-time.

nouns.meaning: sự huy động vốn, gây quỹ
nouns.example: The charity organized a fundraising event to build a new community center.
The office furniture was replaced to create a more ergonomic workspace.
Sending a thank-you note is a nice gesture after a job interview.
Our primary goal is to achieve a 15% increase in sales this quarter.
The warehouse is used to store finished goods before they are shipped.

nouns.meaning: lời than phiền, khiếu nại (trong công việc)
nouns.example: The employee filed a formal grievance regarding unfair treatment.
The restaurant is famous for its mixed grill platter.

adjectives.example: She remained focused on her work despite the noise in the office.
Learning a foreign language is beneficial for international business.
He has become quite forgetful lately, often losing his keys.
To be frank, I don't think the new design will be popular with customers.
The new office layout is both stylish and highly functional.
For further information, please visit our official website.

verbs.meaning: dao động, thay đổi thất thường
verbs.example: Exchange rates fluctuate daily based on market conditions.
We need to focus our efforts on improving customer satisfaction.
Please fold the brochures neatly before putting them in envelopes.
Economists forecast a period of slow growth for the next year.
Don't forget to back up your files before the system update.
The company worked hard to fulfill all customer orders on time.
The elevator is not functioning properly and needs repair.
The manager decided to grill the candidate about his previous experience.

adverbs.example: I look forward to hearing from you soon regarding the job offer.
Frankly, we were surprised by the sudden change in management.
The company's reputation has gradually improved over the years.
